feature: Throttled staged-byte download progress in Picco catalog menu
checks: Accepted partial writes count while failed writes do not
Flush and write errors retain writer behavior
Whole-KiB titles refresh at most once every two seconds
Validation has a distinct Checking book phase
Cancellation discards progress and late completion does not reopen panel
Existing acquisition, duplicate preservation, invalid EPUB and cancellation tests pass
limitations: No total-size percentage, rate estimate or download resume
Fast downloads may finish before progress refresh
No new independent-peer transfer or physical refresh/latency measurement
Byte count does not establish durable storage
